entries.57c4d4a506806c7c: Its strengths are the proprietary metal technology accumulated since its founding in 1939 and, based on it, its development capabilities and production technology capabilities in chemical manufacturing. It handles inorganic and organometallic chemicals across many types and many uses, such as chemicals for surface treatment, chemicals for catalysts, chemicals for batteries and electronic components, and chemicals for ceramics and glass, and is also advancing development of proprietary technologies such as PFAS-free composite plating, which the company developed ahead of the world. Overseas, its subsidiary in Thailand manufactures plating solutions and produces automotive-related products and is in charge of deployment into overseas markets.

entries.7cea53dd3466e4db: Under the medium-term management plan that started in October 2023, it sets out the basic policy "Polish our proprietary metal technology, continue to create new value, and, together with diverse partners, take on the challenge of realizing a sustainable society," and is working on "strengthening the business base and expanding growth domains" and "solving social issues" as basic strategies. It manufactures and sells metal compounds such as copper, tin, nickel and cobalt, metal soaps such as octylic acid, battery chemicals, surface-treatment brighteners and additives, and electroless nickel plating solutions, and carries out contract processing of cathode materials for secondary batteries. The company manufactures and sells the products, and the consolidated subsidiary Siam NKS CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells industrial chemicals in Thailand.
